remediation.analysis: The route builds an SQL query by concatenating the user-controlled `req.query.username` into the SQL string, allowing SQL injection (CWE-89) when passed to `db.all`. SQLite3 supports parameterized queries using `?` placeholders to safely bind untrusted input.
remediation.remediation_strategy: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized SQL statement and pass `username` as a bound parameter to `db.all`, preserving the query logic and response behavior while preventing injection.
assumptions: `db` is an instance of the `sqlite3` Database object supporting `db.all(sql, params, callback)`.
`username` is intended to be treated as a literal value for equality comparison in the WHERE clause.
